inclusions.text: Hotel lobby pickup in an air-conditioned vehicle
inclusions.source: Pickup is from your hotel lobby, in an air-conditioned vehicle, at a pre-arranged time.
The hotel transfer is private to your party; Cleo Park itself is a shared, ticketed venue.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person for the transfer
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the transfer.
The return transfer collects you at the agreed time and brings you back to your hotel.

exclusions.text: Locker hire, food, and beverages sold separately
exclusions.source: Locker hire, food, and beverages are available on-site but sold separately; the entrance fee does not cover in-park spending.
